You are answering a question about a conversation between two people.

Here is what you remember of the conversation:

<record session="session_1" date="1:56 pm on 8 May, 2023" dialogue_ids="D1:1 D1:2">
Caroline: Hey Mel! Good to see you! How have you been?
Melanie: Hey Caroline! Good to see you! I'm swamped with the kids & work. What's up with you? Anything new?
</record>
<record session="session_1" date="1:56 pm on 8 May, 2023" dialogue_ids="D1:9 D1:10">
Caroline: Gonna continue my edu and check out career options, which is pretty exciting!
Melanie: Wow, Caroline! What kinda jobs are you thinkin' of? Anything that stands out?
</record>
<record session="session_1" date="1:56 pm on 8 May, 2023" dialogue_ids="D1:13 D1:14">
Caroline: Thanks, Melanie! That's really sweet. Is this your own painting?
Melanie: Yeah, I painted that lake sunrise last year! It's special to me.
</record>
<record session="session_1" date="1:56 pm on 8 May, 2023" dialogue_ids="D1:17 D1:18">
Caroline: Totally agree, Mel. Relaxing and expressing ourselves is key. Well, I'm off to go do some research.
Melanie: Yep, Caroline. Taking care of ourselves is vital. I'm off to go swimming with the kids. Talk to you soon!
</record>
<record session="session_2" date="1:14 pm on 25 May, 2023" dialogue_ids="D2:1 D2:2">
Melanie: Hey Caroline, since we last chatted, I've had a lot of things happening to me. I ran a charity race for mental health last Saturday – it was really rewarding. Really made me think about taking care of our minds.
Caroline: That charity race sounds great, Mel! Making a difference & raising awareness for mental health is super rewarding - I'm really proud of you for taking part!
</record>
<record session="session_2" date="1:14 pm on 25 May, 2023" dialogue_ids="D2:5 D2:6">
Melanie: Yeah, it's tough. So I'm carving out some me-time each day - running, reading, or playing my violin - which refreshes me and helps me stay present for my fam!
Caroline: That's great, Mel! Taking time for yourself is so important. You're doing an awesome job looking after yourself and your family!
</record>
<record session="session_2" date="1:14 pm on 25 May, 2023" dialogue_ids="D2:7 D2:8">
Melanie: Thanks, Caroline. It's still a work in progress, but I'm doing my best. My kids are so excited about summer break! We're thinking about going camping next month. Any fun plans for the summer?
Caroline: Researching adoption agencies — it's been a dream to have a family and give a loving home to kids who need it.
</record>
<record session="session_2" date="1:14 pm on 25 May, 2023" dialogue_ids="D2:17">
Melanie: No doubts, Caroline. You have such a caring heart - they'll get all the love and stability they need! Excited for this new chapter!
</record>
<record session="session_3" date="7:55 pm on 9 June, 2023" dialogue_ids="D3:9 D3:10">
Caroline: Yeah Mel, let's spread love and understanding! Thanks for the support and encouragement. We can tackle life's challenges together! We got this!
Melanie: Yes, Caroline! We can do it. Your courage is inspiring. I want to be couragous for my family- they motivate me and give me love. What motivates you?
</record>
<record session="session_3" date="7:55 pm on 9 June, 2023" dialogue_ids="D3:11 D3:12">
Caroline: Thanks, Mel! My friends, family and mentors are my rocks – they motivate me and give me the strength to push on. Here's a pic from when we met up last week!
Melanie: Wow, that photo is great! How long have you had such a great support system?
</record>
<record session="session_4" date="10:37 am on 27 June, 2023" dialogue_ids="D4:1 D4:2">
Caroline: Hey Melanie! Long time no talk! A lot's been going on in my life! Take a look at this.
Melanie: Hey, Caroline! Nice to hear from you! Love the necklace, any special meaning to it?
</record>
<record session="session_4" date="10:37 am on 27 June, 2023" dialogue_ids="D4:7 D4:8">
Caroline: Sounds great, Mel. Glad you made some new family mems. How was it? Anything fun?
Melanie: It was an awesome time, Caroline! We explored nature, roasted marshmallows around the campfire and even went on a hike. The view from the top was amazing! The 2 younger kids love nature. It was so special having these moments together as a family - I'll never forget it!
</record>
<record session="session_4" date="10:37 am on 27 June, 2023" dialogue_ids="D4:9 D4:10">
Caroline: That's awesome, Melanie! Family moments like that are so special. Glad y'all had such a great time.
Melanie: Thanks, Caroline! Family time matters to me. What's up with you lately?
</record>
<record session="session_4" date="10:37 am on 27 June, 2023" dialogue_ids="D4:11 D4:12">
Caroline: Lately, I've been looking into counseling and mental health as a career. I want to help people who have gone through the same things as me.
Melanie: Sounds great! What kind of counseling and mental health services do you want to persue?
</record>
<record session="session_4" date="10:37 am on 27 June, 2023" dialogue_ids="D4:17 D4:18">
Caroline: Thanks, Melanie! Your kind words mean a lot.
Melanie: Congrats Caroline! Good on you for going after what you really care about.
</record>
<record session="session_5" date="1:36 pm on 3 July, 2023" dialogue_ids="D5:5 D5:6">
Caroline: Wow, Melanie! I'm getting creative too, just learning the piano. What made you try pottery?
Melanie: I'm a big fan of pottery - the creativity and skill is awesome. Plus, making it is so calming. Look at this!
</record>
<record session="session_5" date="1:36 pm on 3 July, 2023" dialogue_ids="D5:11 D5:12">
Caroline: Wow, Mel, I'm so stoked for you that art is helping you express yourself and bring you joy! Keep it up!
Melanie: Thanks, Caroline! I'm excited to see where pottery takes me. Anything coming up you're looking forward to?
</record>
<record session="session_5" date="1:36 pm on 3 July, 2023" dialogue_ids="D5:15 D5:16">
Caroline: Cool, thanks Mel! Can't wait. I'll keep ya posted. Bye!
Melanie: Bye, Caroline! Can't wait to hear about it. Have fun and stay safe!
</record>
<record session="session_6" date="8:18 pm on 6 July, 2023" dialogue_ids="D6:3 D6:4">
Caroline: Since our last chat, I've been looking into counseling or mental health work more. I'm passionate about helping people and making a positive impact. It's tough, but really rewarding too. Anything new happening with you?
Melanie: That's awesome, Caroline! Congrats on following your dreams. Yesterday I took the kids to the museum - it was so cool spending time with them and seeing their eyes light up!
</record>
<record session="session_6" date="8:18 pm on 6 July, 2023" dialogue_ids="D6:5 D6:6">
Caroline: Melanie, that's a great pic! That must have been awesome. What were they so stoked about?
Melanie: They were stoked for the dinosaur exhibit! They love learning about animals and the bones were so cool. It reminds me why I love being a mom.
</record>
<record session="session_6" date="8:18 pm on 6 July, 2023" dialogue_ids="D6:13 D6:14">
Caroline: Thanks, Melanie! This support network has been amazing. They've been there for me every step of the way giving me love, guidance, and acceptance. I couldn't have done it without them.
Melanie: Wow, Caroline! It's great you have people to support you, that's really awesome!
</record>
<record session="session_7" date="4:33 pm on 12 July, 2023" dialogue_ids="D7:5 D7:6">
Caroline: Thanks, Mell! I'm still looking into counseling and mental health jobs. It's important to me that people have someone to talk to, and I want to help make that happen.
Melanie: Wow, Caroline! You're so inspiring for wanting to help others with their mental health. What's pushing you to keep going forward with it?
</record>
<record session="session_7" date="4:33 pm on 12 July, 2023" dialogue_ids="D7:19 D7:20">
Caroline: Love that purple color! For walking or running?
Melanie: Thanks, Caroline! These are for running. Been running longer since our last chat - a great way to destress and clear my mind.
</record>
<record session="session_7" date="4:33 pm on 12 July, 2023" dialogue_ids="D7:21 D7:22">
Caroline: Wow! What got you into running?
Melanie: I've been running farther to de-stress, which has been great for my headspace.
</record>
<record session="session_7" date="4:33 pm on 12 July, 2023" dialogue_ids="D7:23 D7:24">
Caroline: Cool, Melanie! Running can really boost your mood. Keep it up!
Melanie: Thanks, Caroline! This has been great for my mental health. I'm gonna keep it up.
</record>
<record session="session_7" date="4:33 pm on 12 July, 2023" dialogue_ids="D7:25 D7:26">
Caroline: Awesome, Melanie! Mental health's a priority, so make sure you take care of yourself.
Melanie: Caroline, thanks! Mental health is important to me, and it's made such an improvement!
</record>
<record session="session_7" date="4:33 pm on 12 July, 2023" dialogue_ids="D7:27">
Caroline: Glad it helped ya, Melanie!
</record>
<record session="session_8" date="1:51 pm on 15 July, 2023" dialogue_ids="D8:17 D8:18">
Caroline: Wow, nice pic! You both looked amazing. One special memory for me was this pride parade I went to a few weeks ago.
Melanie: Wow, looks awesome! Did you join in?
</record>
<record session="session_8" date="1:51 pm on 15 July, 2023" dialogue_ids="D8:23 D8:24">
Caroline: It was awesome, Melanie! Being around people who embrace and back me up is beyond words. It really inspired me.
Melanie: Wow, that sounds awesome! Your friends and community really have your back. What's been the best part of it?
</record>
<record session="session_8" date="1:51 pm on 15 July, 2023" dialogue_ids="D8:27 D8:28">
Caroline: Thanks, Melanie! Been a long road, but I'm proud of how far I've come. How're you doing finding peace?
Melanie: I'm getting there, Caroline. Creativity and family keep me at peace.
</record>
<record session="session_8" date="1:51 pm on 15 July, 2023" dialogue_ids="D8:29 D8:30">
Caroline: That's awesome, Melanie! How have your family been supportive during your move?
Melanie: My fam's been awesome - they helped out and showed lots of love and support.
</record>
<record session="session_8" date="1:51 pm on 15 July, 2023" dialogue_ids="D8:31 D8:32">
Caroline: Wow, Mel, family love and support is the best!
Melanie: Yeah, Caroline, my family's been great - their love and support really helped me through tough times. It's awesome! We even went on another camping trip in the forest.
</record>
<record session="session_8" date="1:51 pm on 15 July, 2023" dialogue_ids="D8:33 D8:34">
Caroline: Awesome, Mel! Family support's huge. What else do you guys like doing together?
Melanie: We enjoy hiking in the mountains and exploring forests. It's a cool way to connect with nature and each other.
</record>
<record session="session_8" date="1:51 pm on 15 July, 2023" dialogue_ids="D8:37 D8:38">
Caroline: Thanks, Melanie! Really glad to have you as a friend to share my journey. You're awesome!
Melanie: Thanks, Caroline! Appreciate your friendship. It's great to have a supporter!
</record>
<record session="session_9" date="2:31 pm on 17 July, 2023" dialogue_ids="D9:1 D9:2">
Melanie: Hey Caroline, hope all's good! I had a quiet weekend after we went camping with my fam two weekends ago. It was great to unplug and hang with the kids. What've you been up to? Anything fun over the weekend?
Caroline: Hey Melanie! That sounds great! Last weekend I joined a mentorship program for LGBTQ youth - it's really rewarding to help the community.
</record>
<record session="session_9" date="2:31 pm on 17 July, 2023" dialogue_ids="D9:3 D9:4">
Melanie: Wow, Caroline! It's great that you're helping out. How's it going? Got any cool experiences you can share?
Caroline: The mentoring is going great! I've met some amazing young folks and supported them along the way. It's inspiring to see how resilient and strong they are.
</record>
<record session="session_9" date="2:31 pm on 17 July, 2023" dialogue_ids="D9:7 D9:8">
Melanie: Caroline, awesome news that you two are getting along! What was it like for you both? Care to fill me in?
Caroline: The pride event was awesome! It was so encouraging to be surrounded by so much love and acceptance.
</record>
<record session="session_9" date="2:31 pm on 17 July, 2023" dialogue_ids="D9:9 D9:10">
Melanie: Wow! What's the best part you remember from it?
Caroline: Seeing my mentee's face light up when they saw the support was the best! Such a special moment.
</record>
<record session="session_10" date="8:56 pm on 20 July, 2023" dialogue_ids="D10:1 D10:2">
Caroline: Hey Melanie! Just wanted to say hi!
Melanie: Hey Caroline! Good to talk to you again. What's up? Anything new since last time?
</record>
<record session="session_10" date="8:56 pm on 20 July, 2023" dialogue_ids="D10:19 D10:20">
Caroline: That's great, Mel! What other good memories do you have that make you feel thankful for life?
Melanie: I'll never forget the day my youngest took her first steps. Seeing her wobble as she took those initial steps really put into perspective how fleeting life is and how lucky I am to be able to share these moments.
</record>
<record session="session_11" date="2:24 pm on 14 August, 2023" dialogue_ids="D11:5 D11:6">
Melanie: Wow, that's awesome! How did it feel being part of that community?
Caroline: It was so inspiring, Mel! Check out the crowd. People of all kinds celebrating love and acceptance - it really pushed me to keep fighting for LGBTQ rights.
</record>
<record session="session_11" date="2:24 pm on 14 August, 2023" dialogue_ids="D11:17">
Melanie: Great chatting with you! Feel free to reach out any time.
</record>
<record session="session_12" date="1:50 pm on 17 August, 2023" dialogue_ids="D12:1 D12:2">
Caroline: Hey Mel! How're ya doin'? Recently, I had a not-so-great experience on a hike. I ran into a group of religious conservatives who said something that really upset me. It made me think how much work we still have to do for LGBTQ rights. It's been so helpful to have people around me who accept and support me, so I know I'll be ok!
Melanie: Hey Caroline, sorry about the hike. It sucks when people are so closed-minded. Strong support really helps. FYI, I finished another pottery project - want to see a pic?
</record>
<record session="session_12" date="1:50 pm on 17 August, 2023" dialogue_ids="D12:3 D12:4">
Caroline: Sure thing, Melanie! Can't wait to see your pottery project.  I'm happy you found something that makes you happy. Show me when you can!
Melanie: Here it is. Pretty proud of it! It was a great experience. Thoughts?
</record>
<record session="session_12" date="1:50 pm on 17 August, 2023" dialogue_ids="D12:5 D12:6">
Caroline: That bowl is awesome, Mel! What gave you the idea for all the colors and patterns?
Melanie: Thanks, Caroline! I'm obsessed with those, so I made something to catch the eye and make people smile. Plus, painting helps me express my feelings and be creative. Each stroke carries a part of me.
</record>
<record session="session_12" date="1:50 pm on 17 August, 2023" dialogue_ids="D12:13 D12:14">
Caroline: Thanks, Melanie! It means a lot having you in my corner. Appreciate our friendship!
Melanie: I appreciate our friendship too, Caroline. You've always been there for me.
</record>
<record session="session_12" date="1:50 pm on 17 August, 2023" dialogue_ids="D12:15 D12:16">
Caroline: I'm always here for you, Mel! We had a blast last year at the Pride fest. Those supportive friends definitely make everything worth it!
Melanie: That was a blast! So much fun with the whole gang! Wanna do a family outing this summer?
</record>
<record session="session_12" date="1:50 pm on 17 August, 2023" dialogue_ids="D12:19 D12:20">
Caroline: Sounds great, Mel! We'll make some awesome memories!
Melanie: Yeah, Caroline! I'll start thinking about what we can do.
</record>
<record session="session_12" date="1:50 pm on 17 August, 2023" dialogue_ids="D12:21">
Caroline: Yeah, Mel! Life's all about creating memories. Can't wait for the trip!
</record>
<record session="session_13" date="3:31 pm on 23 August, 2023" dialogue_ids="D13:1 D13:2">
Caroline: Hi Melanie! Hope you're doing good. Guess what I did this week? I took the first step towards becoming a mom - I applied to adoption agencies! It's a big decision, but I think I'm ready to give all my love to a child. I got lots of help from this adoption advice/assistance group I attended. It was great!
Melanie: Caroline, congrats! So proud of you for taking this step. How does it feel? Also, do you have any pets?
</record>
<record session="session_13" date="3:31 pm on 23 August, 2023" dialogue_ids="D13:3 D13:4">
Caroline: Thanks, Mel! Exciting but kinda nerve-wracking. Parenting's such a big responsibility. And yup, I do- Oscar, my guinea pig. He's been great. How are your pets?
Melanie: Yeah, it's normal to be both excited and nervous with a big decision. And thanks for asking, they're good- we got another cat named Bailey too. Here's a pic of Oliver. Can you show me one of Oscar?
</record>
<record session="session_13" date="3:31 pm on 23 August, 2023" dialogue_ids="D13:9 D13:10">
Caroline: Wow, Melanie, that's amazing! Love all the details and how you got the horse's grace and strength. Do you like painting animals?
Melanie: Thanks, Caroline! Glad you like it. Yeah, I love to. It's peaceful and special. Horses have such grace! Do you like to paint too?
</record>
<record session="session_13" date="3:31 pm on 23 August, 2023" dialogue_ids="D13:17 D13:18">
Caroline: Thanks, Melanie! I really appreciate it. Excited for the future! Bye!
Melanie: Bye Caroline. I'm here for you. Take care of yourself.
</record>
<record session="session_14" date="1:33 pm on 25 August, 2023" dialogue_ids="D14:1 D14:2">
Caroline: Hey, Mel! How's it going? There's something I want to tell you. I went hiking last week and got into a bad spot with some people. It really bugged me, so I tried to apologize to them.
Melanie: Wow, Caroline! Sorry that happened to you. It's tough when those things happen, but it's great you apologized. Takes a lot of courage and maturity! What do you think of this?
</record>
<record session="session_14" date="1:33 pm on 25 August, 2023" dialogue_ids="D14:11 D14:12">
Caroline: Wow, Mel, you're amazing! Volunteering and making a difference- it's so heartwarming. You're an inspiration to us all!
Melanie: Thanks, Caroline! I really appreciate your help and motivation. What made you decide to transition and join the transgender community?
</record>
<record session="session_14" date="1:33 pm on 25 August, 2023" dialogue_ids="D14:31 D14:32">
Caroline: Wow, Mel! Any more paintings coming up?
Melanie: I'm feeling inspired by autumn so I'm planning a few. You got any cool art projects coming up?
</record>
<record session="session_15" date="3:19 pm on 28 August, 2023" dialogue_ids="D15:1 D15:2">
Caroline: Hey Melanie, great to hear from you. What's been up since we talked?
Melanie: Hey Caroline! Since we last spoke, I took my kids to a park yesterday. They had fun exploring and playing. It was nice seeing them have a good time outdoors. Time flies, huh? What's new with you?
</record>
<record session="session_15" date="3:19 pm on 28 August, 2023" dialogue_ids="D15:7 D15:8">
Caroline: It was so special to me. It reminded me of my own struggles in the past and how I felt alone. I was glad I could share my story and offer them support - it felt like I could make a difference.
Melanie: That's great. Sharing your story and support might make a difference for a long time. What do you hope to do next time?
</record>
<record session="session_15" date="3:19 pm on 28 August, 2023" dialogue_ids="D15:19 D15:20">
Caroline: Guitar's mostly my thing. Playing it helps me get my emotions out.
Melanie: That's awesome! What type of guitar? Been playing long?
</record>
<record session="session_15" date="3:19 pm on 28 August, 2023" dialogue_ids="D15:25 D15:26">
Caroline: Thanks, Melanie! Appreciate it. You play any instruments?
Melanie: Yeah, I play clarinet! Started when I was young and it's been great. Expression of myself and a way to relax.
</record>
<record session="session_16" date="12:09 am on 13 September, 2023" dialogue_ids="D16:1 D16:2">
Caroline: Hey Mel, long time no chat! I had a wicked day out with the gang last weekend - we went biking and saw some pretty cool stuff. It was so refreshing, and the pic I'm sending is just stunning, eh?
Melanie: Hey Caroline! It's so good to hear from you! That pic is so beautiful, the colors really pop. Biking sounds like a great way to get out in nature. We went camping with the kids a few weeks ago, had a blast exploring the forest and hiking. Nature can be so refreshing for your soul. Any plans coming up?
</record>
<record session="session_16" date="12:09 am on 13 September, 2023" dialogue_ids="D16:17 D16:18">
Caroline: Whoa, Mel, that sign looks serious. Did anything happen?
Melanie: The sign was just a precaution, I had a great time. But thank you for your concern, you're so thoughtful!
</record>
<record session="session_17" date="10:31 am on 13 October, 2023" dialogue_ids="D17:1 D17:2">
Caroline: Hey Mel, what's up? Long time no see! I just contacted my mentor for adoption advice. I'm ready to be a mom and share my love and family. It's a great feeling. Anything new with you? Anything exciting going on?
Melanie: Hey Caroline! Great to hear from you! Wow, what an amazing journey. Congrats!
</record>
<record session="session_17" date="10:31 am on 13 October, 2023" dialogue_ids="D17:9 D17:10">
Caroline: Oh man, sorry to hear that, Melanie. I hope you're okay. Pottery's a great way to relax, so it must have been tough taking a break. Need any help?
Melanie: Thanks, Caroline. It was tough, but I'm doing ok. Been reading that book you recommended a while ago and painting to keep busy.
</record>
<record session="session_17" date="10:31 am on 13 October, 2023" dialogue_ids="D17:25 D17:26">
Caroline: Yep, Melanie! Being ourselves is such a great feeling. It's an ongoing adventure of learning and growing.
Melanie: Yep, Caroline. Life's about learning and exploring. Glad we can be on this trip together.
</record>
<record session="session_18" date="6:55 pm on 20 October, 2023" dialogue_ids="D18:1 D18:2">
Melanie: Hey Caroline, that roadtrip this past weekend was insane! We were all freaked when my son got into an accident. We were so lucky he was okay. It was a real scary experience. Thankfully it's over now. What's been up since we last talked?
Caroline: Oops, sorry 'bout the accident! Must have been traumatizing for you guys. Thank goodness your son's okay. Life sure can be a roller coaster.
</record>
<record session="session_18" date="6:55 pm on 20 October, 2023" dialogue_ids="D18:5 D18:6">
Melanie: Yeah, you're right, Caroline. Family's super important to me. Especially after the accident, I've thought a lot about how much I need them. They mean the world to me and I'm so thankful to have them. Thankfully, they enjoyed the Grand Canyon a lot!
Caroline: The kids look so cute, Mel! I bet they bring lots of joy. How did they handle the accident?
</record>
<record session="session_18" date="6:55 pm on 20 October, 2023" dialogue_ids="D18:9 D18:10">
Melanie: They're really amazing. Wish I was that resilient too. But they give me the strength to keep going.
Caroline: Our loved ones give us strength to tackle any challenge - it's amazing!
</record>
<record session="session_18" date="6:55 pm on 20 October, 2023" dialogue_ids="D18:11 D18:12">
Melanie: Yeah, Caroline. Totally agree. They're my biggest motivation and support.
Caroline: It's so sweet to see your love for your family, Melanie. They really are your rock.
</record>
<record session="session_18" date="6:55 pm on 20 October, 2023" dialogue_ids="D18:13 D18:14">
Melanie: Thanks, Caroline. They're a real support. Appreciate them a lot.
Caroline: Glad you've got people to lean on, Melanie. It helps during tougher times.
</record>
<record session="session_18" date="6:55 pm on 20 October, 2023" dialogue_ids="D18:15 D18:16">
Melanie: Yeah for sure. Having my fam around helps a lot. It makes hard times easier.
Caroline: Wow, great pic! Is that recent? Looks like you all had fun!
</record>
<record session="session_18" date="6:55 pm on 20 October, 2023" dialogue_ids="D18:17 D18:18">
Melanie: Thanks, Caroline! Yup, we just did it yesterday! The kids loved it and it was a nice way to relax after the road trip.
Caroline: Glad you got some R&R after the drive. Nature sure seems to refresh us, huh?
</record>
<record session="session_18" date="6:55 pm on 20 October, 2023" dialogue_ids="D18:19 D18:20">
Melanie: Absolutely! It really helps me reset and recharge. I love camping trips with my fam, 'cause nature brings such peace and serenity.
Caroline: Wow, that's awesome! What do you love most about camping with your fam?
</record>
<record session="session_18" date="6:55 pm on 20 October, 2023" dialogue_ids="D18:21 D18:22">
Melanie: It's a chance to be present and together. We bond over stories, campfires and nature. It's so peaceful waking up to the sound of birds and the smell of fresh air - it always refreshes my soul.
Caroline: That's so peaceful and calming, Melanie! I can picture waking up to nature. It's great that you get to spend quality, tranquil time with your family.
</record>
<record session="session_19" date="9:55 am on 22 October, 2023" dialogue_ids="D19:11 D19:12">
Caroline: Thanks, Melanie. Your support really means a lot. This journey has been amazing and I'm grateful I get to share it and help others with theirs. It's a real gift.
Melanie: Absolutely! I'm so glad we can always be there for each other.
</record>
<record session="session_19" date="9:55 am on 22 October, 2023" dialogue_ids="D19:13 D19:14">
Caroline: Glad you agree, Caroline. Appreciate the support of those close to me. Their encouragement made me who I am.
Melanie: Glad you had support. Being yourself is great!
</record>

Joanna: Creating stories and watching them come alive gives me happiness and fulfillment. Writing has been such a blessing for me.
</record>
<record session="session_27" date="8:10 pm on 7 November, 2022" dialogue_ids="D27:11 D27:12">

Joanna: Yep! I actually just submitted a few more last week! Hoping to hear back from them soon, though I assume a few will be rejected.
</record>
<record session="session_27" date="8:10 pm on 7 November, 2022" dialogue_ids="D27:13 D27:14">
Nate: Even if it happens to a few, I'm sure at leasts one will make it to the screens and be your 3rd published movie!
Joanna: Thanks, Nate! Appreciate the encouragement. I won't give up, I promise! Got it covered!
</record>
<record session="session_27" date="8:10 pm on 7 November, 2022" dialogue_ids="D27:15 D27:16">
Nate: Great to hear! On another note, I just upgraded some of my equipment at home. Check it out!
Joanna: Oh wow, ice set-up! Do you use that computer for gaming?
</record>
<record session="session_27" date="8:10 pm on 7 November, 2022" dialogue_ids="D27:17 D27:18">
Nate: Yep! This is where I practice and compete. Sometimes I even use it when I'm playing games with friends.
Joanna: Cool! Having a dedicated space for practice and competition should help you stay focused.
</record>
<record session="session_27" date="8:10 pm on 7 November, 2022" dialogue_ids="D27:21 D27:22">
Nate: It really is! But it's also really important to have something like this for my career, otherwise I would never be able to beat my competition.
Joanna: That makes sense! It's all about practice isn't it? So what's your favorite game?
</record>
<record session="session_27" date="8:10 pm on 7 November, 2022" dialogue_ids="D27:23 D27:24">
Nate: Yep! I'm currently playing this awesome fantasy RPG called "Xeonoblade Chronicles" and it's been a blast! I highly reccomend it if you've never played it before. 
Joanna: What made you start playing it? That's a japanese game series right?
</record>
<record session="session_27" date="8:10 pm on 7 November, 2022" dialogue_ids="D27:25 D27:26">
Nate: Yes it is! I'm a big fan of Nintendo games, and I've actually been wanting to play this one for a while because my friends have played it and reccomended it!
Joanna: Nice! It's really cool when a reccomendation from a friend fits your taste so well isn't it?
</record>
<record session="session_27" date="8:10 pm on 7 November, 2022" dialogue_ids="D27:27 D27:28">
Nate: For sure! That's why I love when you give me movie reccomendations, I usually like them a lot more then if I were to just watch some random one.
Joanna: Great to hear! I just finished with the intro to my next movie script, and I decided to include this at the begining.
</record>
<record session="session_27" date="8:10 pm on 7 November, 2022" dialogue_ids="D27:29 D27:30">
Nate: That letter is really awesome! Does it remind you of your childhood?
Joanna: Yeah, it does! My brother wrote it - he used to make me these cute notes when we were kids. Brings back sweet memories.
</record>
<record session="session_27" date="8:10 pm on 7 November, 2022" dialogue_ids="D27:31 D27:32">
Nate: Aww, childhood memories can be so powerful!
Joanna: They sure can! They take us back to simpler times but it's nice to create new memories as we grow up.
</record>
<record session="session_27" date="8:10 pm on 7 November, 2022" dialogue_ids="D27:35 D27:36">
Nate: Dang, your full of great ideas Joanna! I really should start doing that as well, or at least write down the things my animals like a lot!
Joanna: You should! I completely encourage it, looking back on fond memories is such a blessing.
</record>
<record session="session_27" date="8:10 pm on 7 November, 2022" dialogue_ids="D27:37 D27:38">
Nate: Ok I will! But I'll also start writing down some of my favorite memories with you from now on.
Joanna: Definitely, let's keep making great memories and supporting each other. Let's keep reaching for our dreams and make them happen!
</record>
<record session="session_28" date="5:54 pm on 9 November, 2022" dialogue_ids="D28:1 D28:2">
Nate: Hey Joanna, what a wild week! My game tournament got pushed back, so I tried out some cooking. Look at this homemade coconut ice cream! The sprinkles kinda changed the color this time around.
Joanna: Hey Nate, that looks yummy! Wish I could try it, but I can't right now. How did the last game tournament go?
</record>
<record session="session_28" date="5:54 pm on 9 November, 2022" dialogue_ids="D28:3 D28:4">
Nate: Hey Joanna, thanks! Tough tournament, didn't make it to the finals. But that's okay, I'll get 'em next time!
Joanna: Aww, bummer! But the important thing is to stay positive. So, what's your next move in the gaming world?
</record>
<record session="session_28" date="5:54 pm on 9 November, 2022" dialogue_ids="D28:5 D28:6">

Joanna: Sounds great, Nate! Making a switch could open up new opportunities. Wishing you luck with picking the right team!
</record>
<record session="session_28" date="5:54 pm on 9 November, 2022" dialogue_ids="D28:7 D28:8">
Nate: Thanks, Joanna! I really appreciate it. It's a big decision, but I'm excited for what the future holds. How about you? Anything exciting happening on your end?
Joanna: Yup! I worked hard on another script and eventually created a plan for getting it made into a movie. It was a ton of work but satisfying. I pitched it to some producers yesterday and they really liked it. It gave me a big confidence boost!
</record>
<record session="session_28" date="5:54 pm on 9 November, 2022" dialogue_ids="D28:9 D28:10">
Nate: Congrats on the chance to pitch your script - super impressive. Proud of you!
Joanna: Appreciate you, Nate! Your support and encouragement mean a lot to me. I feel like I just can't stop writing write now!
</record>
<record session="session_28" date="5:54 pm on 9 November, 2022" dialogue_ids="D28:11 D28:12">
Nate: Anytime. What're you working on in that notebook? Anything cool?
Joanna: Hey Nate, I'm working on a new project - a suspenseful thriller set in a small Midwestern town. It's been a great creative outlet for me. How about you? Do you have any projects you're working on?
</record>
<record session="session_28" date="5:54 pm on 9 November, 2022" dialogue_ids="D28:13 D28:14">
Nate: Yeah actually - creating gaming content for YouTube. It's a cool way to entertain folks and satisfy my video game cravings at the same time when there aren't any tourneys going on.
Joanna: Wow, that's a cool idea! What inspired you to start making gaming videos?
</record>
<record session="session_28" date="5:54 pm on 9 November, 2022" dialogue_ids="D28:15 D28:16">
Nate: Hey Joanna, I'm a big fan of them and thought it would be a fun idea to start making them myself. I'm hoping to share my love of gaming and connect with others who enjoy it too.
Joanna: Way to go, Nate! Making videos and connecting with people about gaming - that's awesome! You'll do great!
</record>
<record session="session_28" date="5:54 pm on 9 November, 2022" dialogue_ids="D28:17 D28:18">
Nate: Thanks Joanna! Appreciate the support. It's new to me but I'm excited to get started!
Joanna: Make sure you watch other peoples videos first so you get a handle on what your audience likes! That way your videos don't flop when you post them.
</record>
<record session="session_28" date="5:54 pm on 9 November, 2022" dialogue_ids="D28:19 D28:20">
Nate: Already doing that, but thanks for the advice!
Joanna: No worries, Nate! It's great to support each other in reaching our goals. On another note, check out this pic I got a while back!
</record>
<record session="session_28" date="5:54 pm on 9 November, 2022" dialogue_ids="D28:21 D28:22">
Nate: Wow, that sunset pic looks incredible! What inspired you to take that photo?
Joanna: Thanks, Nate! I took that pic on a hike last summer near Fort Wayne. The sunset and the surrounding beauty were just incredible. It was an awesome reminder of nature's beauty.
</record>
<record session="session_28" date="5:54 pm on 9 November, 2022" dialogue_ids="D28:23 D28:24">
Nate: That sounds incredible! Nature truly has a way of reminding us to appreciate the beauty around us, and moments like those really stay with you. These critters also make me appreciate life's little joys. And guess what? I got them a new friend!
Joanna: Wow, what made you get a third?
</record>
<record session="session_28" date="5:54 pm on 9 November, 2022" dialogue_ids="D28:27 D28:28">
Nate: You got that right, but I'm very happy with the descision and wouldn't have it any other way.
Joanna: Can I come over sometime and watch you play with them? From a distance I mean, since I'm allergic.
</record>
<record session="session_28" date="5:54 pm on 9 November, 2022" dialogue_ids="D28:29 D28:30">
Nate: Definitely! I'd love to have you over again. Maybe we can watch one of your movies together or go to the park!
Joanna: For sure! I'd love to do either of those things with you!
</record>
<record session="session_28" date="5:54 pm on 9 November, 2022" dialogue_ids="D28:31 D28:32">
Nate: Sounds good. Well I'll make sure I give the turtles a bath before you get here so they're ready to play.
Joanna: Alright, see you tomorrow!
</record>
<record session="session_28" date="5:54 pm on 9 November, 2022" dialogue_ids="D28:33">
Nate: Bye Joanna!
</record>
<record session="session_29" date="12:06 am on 11 November, 2022" dialogue_ids="D29:1 D29:2">
Joanna: Nate, can you believe it? I'm finally filming my own movie from the road-trip script!
Nate: Congrats, Joanna! Not surprised at all that your hard work paid off. Must feel awesome to see your script come alive in a movie! Pretty cool when something you love brings success, right? Tell me more about your movie!
</record>
<record session="session_29" date="12:06 am on 11 November, 2022" dialogue_ids="D29:3 D29:4">
Joanna: Woohoo, thanks Nate! It's pretty wild to see it come alive. Every day on set is awesome and full of potential. Being able to show my vision is awesome.
Nate: I think so too! What's been the coolest moment on set?
</record>
<record session="session_29" date="12:06 am on 11 November, 2022" dialogue_ids="D29:5 D29:6">
Joanna: One of the actors came up to me and told me how much she liked my script! I was so excited when that happened - it gave me chills!
Nate: Wow Joanna, that must have been so exciting! It's incredible when you get those moments of joy. Anyway, I took my turtles to the beach in Tampa yesterday! They always bring me peace in the craziness of life.
</record>
<record session="session_29" date="12:06 am on 11 November, 2022" dialogue_ids="D29:7 D29:8">
Joanna: Woah, that's awesome, Nate! You must really enjoy having them around - they're so cool! What do you love most about having them?
Nate: Your completely right! I really love having them around. They're so cool and they make me feel calm. Plus, they don't require much looking after, which is great. I love seeing them soaking in the sun like this.
</record>
<record session="session_29" date="12:06 am on 11 November, 2022" dialogue_ids="D29:9 D29:10">
Joanna: That's awesome, Nate! They look so serene and happy. It's great to have something like that.
Nate: Yeah, turtles are like zen masters! They always remind me to slow down and appreciate the small things in life. I'm loving experimenting with flavors right now. Here are some colorful bowls of coconut milk ice cream that I made.
</record>
<record session="session_29" date="12:06 am on 11 November, 2022" dialogue_ids="D29:11 D29:12">
Joanna: Hey Nate, that looks really yummy! The colors and mix-ins give it a nice kick.
Nate: Nice! I'm glad you like it too. This recipe really jazzes it up. Wanna give it a try?
</record>
<record session="session_29" date="12:06 am on 11 November, 2022" dialogue_ids="D29:13 D29:14">
Joanna: Definitely, Nate! That ice cream looks mouthwatering. Thanks so much for offering!
Nate: No worries, Joanna. Hope you enjoy it!
</record>
<record session="session_29" date="12:06 am on 11 November, 2022" dialogue_ids="D29:15">
Joanna: Yea, no worries! It was great catching up. Take it easy!
</record>

<record session="session_27" date="8:10 pm on 7 November, 2022" dialogue_ids="D27:19 D27:20">

<record session="session_27" date="8:10 pm on 7 November, 2022" dialogue_ids="D27:21 D27:22">

<record session="session_27" date="8:10 pm on 7 November, 2022" dialogue_ids="D27:25 D27:26">

<record session="session_27" date="8:10 pm on 7 November, 2022" dialogue_ids="D27:27 D27:28">

<record session="session_27" date="8:10 pm on 7 November, 2022" dialogue_ids="D27:29 D27:30">

<record session="session_27" date="8:10 pm on 7 November, 2022" dialogue_ids="D27:31 D27:32">

</record>
<record session="session_27" date="8:10 pm on 7 November, 2022" dialogue_ids="D27:33 D27:34">

</record>
<record session="session_27" date="8:10 pm on 7 November, 2022" dialogue_ids="D27:35 D27:36">

</record>
<record session="session_27" date="8:10 pm on 7 November, 2022" dialogue_ids="D27:37 D27:38">

</record>

<record session="session_28" date="5:54 pm on 9 November, 2022" dialogue_ids="D28:3 D28:4">

<record session="session_28" date="5:54 pm on 9 November, 2022" dialogue_ids="D28:5 D28:6">

<record session="session_28" date="5:54 pm on 9 November, 2022" dialogue_ids="D28:7 D28:8">

</record>

</record>

</record>
<record session="session_28" date="5:54 pm on 9 November, 2022" dialogue_ids="D28:15 D28:16">

</record>

<record session="session_4" date="2:13 pm on 4 April, 2022" dialogue_ids="D4:1 D4:2">
John: Hey James! Long time no chat. What's up? Been playing any new games lately?
James: Hey John! Yeah, it's been a while. I've been busy, but I joined an online gaming tournament yesterday. It was so intense and fun! Here is a photo report.
</record>
<record session="session_10" date="12:45 am on 8 May, 2022" dialogue_ids="D10:1 D10:2">
James: Hey John! Been a while since we chatted. Sorry 'bout not getting back sooner. How's it going? Any new games you're into?
John: Hey James! No worries, I know you are really busy at work. I'm good, thanks for asking. Oh, I've been organizing something with my friends yesterday - it was cool! Guess what it was, I'll give you a little hint.
</record>
<record session="session_10" date="12:45 am on 8 May, 2022" dialogue_ids="D10:3 D10:4">
James: Wow, John, that looks awesome! Is it an icon of a new game?
John: Nope, not a new game. We put together a tournament for our favorite game, CS:GO. Lots showed up and we made a bunch of money for charity!
</record>
<record session="session_10" date="12:45 am on 8 May, 2022" dialogue_ids="D10:5 D10:6">
James: Wow John, organizing that tournament for charity must have been a ton of effort, but it sounds like it was so worth it!
John: Definitely worth it! It took some planning and coordination, but seeing everyone come together for a good cause was so rewarding.
</record>
<record session="session_10" date="12:45 am on 8 May, 2022" dialogue_ids="D10:7 D10:8">
James: It must have been great to see the results of that effort. Have you considered organizing more events like that in the future?
John: Yeah, for sure! It was awesome and I want to do more events like that. It combines my interests and helps the community. Plus, it's great to get people together for some friendly competition.
</record>
<record session="session_10" date="12:45 am on 8 May, 2022" dialogue_ids="D10:9 D10:10">
James: Combining gaming and volunteering is a great idea! So fun and fulfilling. Where did you send the collected money?
John: Our main goal was to raise money for a dog shelter, which is not far from the street where I live. And we did it!
</record>
<record session="session_12" date="7:33 pm on 23 May, 2022" dialogue_ids="D12:3 D12:4">
James: Of course, I also managed to ride the Ferris wheel, electric cars and buggies. What's new with you?
John: That's really cool! Last Friday I entered a local tournament and took second place! It was a wild experience and the competitive energy was insane.
</record>
<record session="session_12" date="7:33 pm on 23 May, 2022" dialogue_ids="D12:5 D12:6">
James: Wow, John that's awesome! Congrats on your achievement! I can imagine the rush you must have felt during the tournament. Did you receive any rewards or prizes for your success?
John: I was stoked about my achievement. Though I didn't win the tournament, I still received some money for the 2nd place. Seeing my effort pay off was awesome.
</record>
<record session="session_15" date="9:59 pm on 19 June, 2022" dialogue_ids="D15:9 D15:10">
James: Wow, John that sounds great! I'm sure with your skills and passion, you could do some really cool things with nonprofits. Here's a pic I took when I volunteered last month. It was really rewarding to see how little gifts can do so much!
John: That's awesome, James! Was it cool to see the impact of the gifts? Can you tell me more about the organization you volunteered with?
</record>
<record session="session_17" date="9:49 am on 22 July, 2022" dialogue_ids="D17:1 D17:2">
John: Hi James! I just started playing chess to get better at strategy. I'm loving it! Have you ever tried it out?
James: Hey John! Yeah, I've played chess before. It's a game that really tests your strategy. It's great that you're enjoying it!
</record>
<record session="session_17" date="9:49 am on 22 July, 2022" dialogue_ids="D17:5 D17:6">
John: I'm playing mostly online for now, but I also joined a chess club and practice with others. Here's a pic from an intense game I played lately.
James: Wow, looks intense! What sparked your interest in chess?
</record>
<record session="session_18" date="1:45 pm on 6 August, 2022" dialogue_ids="D18:7 D18:8">
John: Your support means a lot. Lately, I've been thinking about what truly makes me happy, and I'm really drawn to the gaming industry. I'm passionate about it and it's time to turn that into a career. I want to become an organizer of tournaments for various computer games in our state. For example, for CS:GO. It's a new journey for me.
James: Cool! You always mentioned your love for gaming. What other game do you want to organize competitions for? And what`s your plan now?
</record>
<record session="session_18" date="1:45 pm on 6 August, 2022" dialogue_ids="D18:9 D18:10">
John: Also, I can host Fortnite competitions. I have already made some connections that will help me with this. My plan is to gain more experience and perfect my skills to be successful in this field.
James: Sounds like a solid plan! Trying out different game genres can be a great way to widen your skills and knowledge.
</record>
<record session="session_19" date="9:16 am on 10 August, 2022" dialogue_ids="D19:3 D19:4">
John: Lately, I've been playing some different genres like strategy and RPG games instead of my usual shooters. I’m already thinking about making competitions for them too.
James: That's great, John! Trying out different genres can really add to your gaming experiences. Have you come across any standout games?
</record>
<record session="session_20" date="3:57 pm on 21 August, 2022" dialogue_ids="D20:7 D20:8">
John: I think not, this is just a one-time experience to learn something new and work as a team. I'm still full of courage to start hosting eSports competitions. Do you participate in any online groups?
James: Nah, not in any online groups right now, but I do have my gaming group I play with regularly. We even stream our game sessions, and recently had a get-together. Super fun!
</record>
<record session="session_20" date="3:57 pm on 21 August, 2022" dialogue_ids="D20:13 D20:14">
John: Sounds great! Gaming marathons are the best. When I was younger, my siblings threw me one and it was awesome! We stayed up all night playing games and it really bonded us.
James: Wow, that sounds awesome! Do you still play with your siblings these days?
</record>
<record session="session_20" date="3:57 pm on 21 August, 2022" dialogue_ids="D20:15 D20:16">
John: Me and my siblings don't hang out much since we live far apart, but when we do we always try to plan a gaming night.
James: Sounds great, John! Family time is the best. Are you planning any gaming nights in the near future?
</record>
<record session="session_20" date="3:57 pm on 21 August, 2022" dialogue_ids="D20:17 D20:18">
John: Yep, I'm organizing one with my siblings next month. We're stoked! Can't wait!
James: Wow, John! Family game nights are so much fun. Have a great time!
</record>
<record session="session_24" date="6:02 pm on 18 September, 2022" dialogue_ids="D24:1 D24:2">
John: Hey James! Long time no see! A lot's changed since we talked. I started getting into board games. I tried one last week and it turned out to be a lot of fun. What's new with you?
James: Hey John! Cool, what kind of board game is this? I had a lot to do all this time. And in order not to forget to do something, I started writing down everything I needed in a notebook.
</record>
<record session="session_24" date="6:02 pm on 18 September, 2022" dialogue_ids="D24:15 D24:16">
John: Playing drums when I was younger was a fun way to let off steam. Here's a photo of an old drum set I used to play on.
James: Cool! Have you ever been in a band or just jammed with friends?
</record>
<record session="session_24" date="6:02 pm on 18 September, 2022" dialogue_ids="D24:17 D24:18">
John: I've jammed with friends before, it was a lot of fun!
James: Sounds awesome! Jamming with friends is always a blast. Do you have any recordings or videos of those sessions?
</record>
<record session="session_26" date="9:20 am on 3 October, 2022" dialogue_ids="D26:1 D26:2">
John: Hey James! Busy few weeks for sure, but I'm pushing through. Got an email about a volunteer gig at a game dev non-profit. It's something I've wanted to do for a while, and could be the perfect start to a career that combines my two loves - gaming and helping. So stoked!
James: Hey John, that sounds awesome! Combining your two loves - gaming and helping people - must be really exciting! So what kind of gig did they offer you?
</record>
<record session="session_27" date="2:14 pm on 13 October, 2022" dialogue_ids="D27:1 D27:2">
John: Hey James! How's it going? I had a blast last week when my programmer friends and I organized an online comp. It was awesome to see everyone show off their skills! Anything new in your life?
James: Hey John, congrats! Something cool happened to me recently. I made my first game and released it for the gaming community - it was so exciting!
</record>
<record session="session_29" date="12:37 am on 31 October, 2022" dialogue_ids="D29:1 D29:2">
John: Hey James! Hope you're doing great. I've some amazing news - I held a gaming tourney with my buddies last night. We played Fortnite and a few other games. We raised a decent amount for a children's hospital. Combining gaming and a good cause felt awesome!
James: Hey John! Awesome job organizing a gaming tournament for a children's hospital! Combining gaming and a good cause - that's really cool! Tell me more about who helped out and what other games were played.
</record>
<record session="session_29" date="12:37 am on 31 October, 2022" dialogue_ids="D29:3 D29:4">
John: Thanks! We all pulled together for a great cause. My gaming pals and I also played Overwatch and Apex Legends. Everyone had a blast raising money for the kids' hospital. The atmosphere was awesome and everyone was so competitive. In the end, we raised a good amount. Feels good to use our love of gaming for good!
James: Wow, that sounds like a blast! It's great how gaming can bring people together like that. You made a huge difference in the kids' lives! Do you have any photos from the tournament?
</record>
<record session="session_29" date="12:37 am on 31 October, 2022" dialogue_ids="D29:5 D29:6">
John: I got a great shot at the tournament. Check it out! Everyone was so hyped, and it felt great knowing we were playing for a good cause.
James: Wow, this photo rocks!
</record>
<record session="session_30" date="5:20 pm on 5 November, 2022" dialogue_ids="D30:3 D30:4">
James: That's great news. What did you do?
John: I won the regional chess tournament. It was intense but I came out on top!
</record>
<record session="session_30" date="5:20 pm on 5 November, 2022" dialogue_ids="D30:15 D30:16">
James: Wow, that sounds awesome! I just wanted to try a new gaming genre, so why not try the sports genre.
John: You need to practice a little first, and then we can play together.
</record>
